task_definition.task_description: Please reserve the best available recommendation for one pair of Sony WH-1000XM5 headphones in the audio category for me, then use that selected item to build the cart. After that, get Alice’s contact info, generate an invoice for the item using the SAVE15 coupon and PayPal, send me an email notification about it, and then confirm the order.
